section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing removal of ring gear using a hammer to tap on it

items: (a) Remove the ring gear set bolts and lock plates.
(b) Place matchmarks on the ring gear and differential case.
(c) Using a plastic or copper hammer, tap on the ring gear to separate it from the differential case.

content.description: Illustration showing disassembly of differential case with hammer and punch

content.text: Using a hammer and punch, drive out the straight pin. Remove the pinion shaft, two pinion gears, two side gears and two thrust washers.

content.description: Illustration showing assembly of differential case with side gears and thrust washers

content.text: Select thrust washers from the table below that will ensure the backlash is within specification. Try to select washers of the same thickness for both sides.
Install thrust washers and side gears in the differential case.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of thrust washers and side gears in differential case
Illustration showing measurement of side gear backlash with pinion gear held toward case

content.text: Measure the side gear backlash while holding one pinion gear toward the case.
If the backlash is not within specification, install a thrust washer of different thickness.
